description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class that manages content pages within an administrative web application. It handles HTTP requests related to listing, creating, viewing, deleting, and saving content pages, primarily through annotated methods for URL routing and request processing. The class interacts with content service layers, manages content descriptions in multiple languages, and enforces role-based security.

classes.name: ContentPagesController
classes.description: Controller class managing content pages in admin panel, including CRUD operations and content validation.

methods.name: listContentPages
methods.description: Handles GET request to list content pages, sets up menu and returns the view for content pages.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Handles GET request to initialize creation form for a new content page, setting default content and descriptions.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific content page by ID, ensures proper permissions and content type.

methods.name: removeContent
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a content page by ID, responds with Ajax JSON indicating success or failure.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Handles POST request to retrieve a list of static content pages by type, returns data as JSON.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST form submission to save or update a content page, validates input, and associates descriptions with languages.

methods.name: checkContentCode
methods.description: Handles POST request for AJAX validation to check if a content code is unique within the merchant store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set up navigation menu context for the views.
